text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Is this... an error? Still, considering 
that...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Elevated pulse and chest tightness 
detected. Determined to be an abnormal 
state of excitement.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Based on the above, I estimate my status 
as "shivering with anticipation."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ...I shall deliver victory to you, Master.
